According to ScenTree it was originally isolated from jasmine absolute; it appears in jasmine grandiflorum (40–65 %), ylang-ylang extra and narcissus absolute. Part of the data on dose, tenacity and note (Perfumer's World, Perfume Extract, Perfumer's Apprentice, Purenso, Olfactorian, Pell Wall, Symrise) come from the search-engine snippets, not from opened pages.

Flavour: type fruity; Mosciano 1990 at 30 ppm: fruity and sweet with balsamic and jasmine-flower nuances. WebFetch readings limited to the first 100,000 of 175,341 characters. EU MSDI 1200 and US 850 µg/capita/day; structural class I.
